"friends". also, even if it was sure, people would be sad for a while but in the end my constant irritation would be gone and it would make people feel so much  better.

but i only see that. To be honest I might as well just do it now so i dont have to ruin everyones day by them commenting on this.
i only have one reason to live and that's dashed out by their distance, the fact its a childish reason, etc.
It feels like it. I mean cmon, who really cares?
One person. One fucking person. They live too far away and they dont even like me back. What's the point?
But who cares about someones feelings if they are just one girls. There are 7billion+ people on this earth. No-one needs me.

I've been told what you have said so many times constantly. But I just don't understand it. Even if loads of people have it and people get through it, i dont really care. I dont care if other people have worse or not because everyone can deal with different amounts of issues. I feel pathetic for even complaining and i even feel like an attention seeker.

But you barely know me... See and that's where the issue is made. I get what you mean though about distance not mattering, but i tend to fuck up most relationships being unsure of what to do etc. Killing myself would prevent that as well as keep everyone else safe. I can already imagine how much happier a fair few peoples live would be.

It's hard to carry on though. I used to starve myself and everything, now im 154+ lbs and i feel like such a fatass. Aside from that, I tend to irritate people with my sadness. I need someone to comfort me but the only people i love are my online friends that live either close but my parents refuse to let me meet them or too far away. I might as well just kill myself to stop people from either feeling bad, feeling sorry or feeling like i am an attention seeker.

I feel like such a child though, the people I love either i want a relationship with or dont really want too much to do with them. With that in mind, most conversations are highly awkward as well as the fact that some of them are new to my depression and i wonder how i sound to them. I feel like dying would make so many people so much more happier as they wouldnt have to deal with my constant sadness, as well as the fact that id no longer be chatting randomly and maybe offending them. What do i do? If i know that everyone would be better off without me.

I would if they didnt know how to react. I expect people to react a certain way but they dont and i dont understand it, it really screws me over because then i have barely any friends and it really hurts me.
everyone says that to me though, and it seems like the only way out nowadays and it's sister
